## Overview

Compute per-tree D1F distances for `chr2_2inds_allpops` in the LCT interval by comparing each tree's F-matrix to a theoretical Kingman mean reference.

Inputs:

- `trees/chr2_2inds_allpops.tree`
- `results/chr2_2inds_allpops_breaks.csv`

Output:

- `results/chr2_2inds_allpops_d1f_per_tree.csv`

## Setup

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ape)
library(phylodyn)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(fmatrix)
library(progress)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
base_dir <- normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
trees_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "trees")
results_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results")
cache_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "fmatrix_cache")
if (!dir.exists(cache_dir)) {
  dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

CHR <- 2L
N_INDS_PER_POP <- 2L
N_DEFAULT <- 52L
F_DIM_TARGET <- N_DEFAULT - 1L
STEM <- sprintf("chr%d_%dinds_allpops", CHR, N_INDS_PER_POP)

newick_path <- file.path(trees_dir, sprintf("%s.tree", STEM))
breaks_path <- file.path(results_dir, sprintf("%s_breaks.csv", STEM))
out_csv <- file.path(results_dir, sprintf("%s_d1f_per_tree.csv", STEM))
out_ref_rds <- file.path(results_dir, sprintf("%s_F_kingman_reference.rds", STEM))
out_f_cache_rds <- file.path(cache_dir, sprintf("%s_raw_fmats.rds", STEM))

stopifnot(file.exists(newick_path))
stopifnot(file.exists(breaks_path))
```

## Kingman reference F-matrix (fixed n=52)

```{r}
dist_d1 <- function(F1, F2) {
  sum(abs(F1 - F2))
}

trim_F_to_target <- function(Fm, target_dim = F_DIM_TARGET) {
  if (!is.matrix(Fm)) {
    stop("F matrix must be a matrix.")
  }
  if (nrow(Fm) < target_dim || ncol(Fm) < target_dim) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "F matrix is smaller than target (%d x %d): got %d x %d",
      target_dim, target_dim, nrow(Fm), ncol(Fm)
    ))
  }
  Fm[seq_len(target_dim), seq_len(target_dim), drop = FALSE]
}

as_reference_F <- function(obj, tol = 8L) {
  if (is.matrix(obj)) {
    return(obj)
  }
  if (inherits(obj, "phylo")) {
    return(phylodyn::gen_Fmat(obj, tol = tol))
  }
  if (is.list(obj) && !is.null(obj$F) && is.matrix(obj$F)) {
    return(obj$F)
  }
  stop("Unsupported object returned by kingman function.")
}

n_tips <- as.integer(N_DEFAULT)
ref_method <- "kingman_m"
if (exists("kingman_f", where = asNamespace("fmatrix"), inherits = FALSE)) {
  k_obj <- get("kingman_f", envir = asNamespace("fmatrix"))(n = n_tips)
  ref_method <- "kingman_f"
} else {
  k_obj <- fmatrix::kingman_m(n = n_tips)
}

F_mean_kingman <- as_reference_F(k_obj, tol = 8L)
F_mean_kingman <- trim_F_to_target(F_mean_kingman, target_dim = F_DIM_TARGET)

saveRDS(F_mean_kingman, out_ref_rds)
cat("Saved Kingman reference F-matrix:", out_ref_rds, "\n")
cat("Reference method:", ref_method, "\n")
```

## Compute per-tree D1F and save CSV

```{r}
# Mimics chr2_50samples_d1f.Rmd workflow: load all trees once, then vapply.
trees <- ape::read.tree(newick_path)
if (inherits(trees, "phylo")) {
  trees <- structure(list(trees), class = "multiPhylo")
}

breaks_df <- readr::read_csv(breaks_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(tree_index)

cat("Trees loaded:", length(trees), "\n")
cat("Break rows   :", nrow(breaks_df), "\n")

n_use <- min(length(trees), nrow(breaks_df))
if (n_use == 0) {
  stop("No overlapping trees and break rows.")
}
if (length(trees) != nrow(breaks_df)) {
  warning(sprintf(
    "Length mismatch (trees=%d, breaks=%d). Truncating to %d.",
    length(trees), nrow(breaks_df), n_use
  ))
}

force_recompute_f_cache <- FALSE

cache_valid <- function(obj, n_need, target_dim) {
  if (!is.list(obj) || length(obj) < n_need) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  idx <- seq_len(n_need)
  all(vapply(idx, function(i) {
    m <- obj[[i]]
    is.matrix(m) && nrow(m) >= target_dim && ncol(m) >= target_dim
  }, logical(1)))
}

F_list <- NULL
if (file.exists(out_f_cache_rds) && !isTRUE(force_recompute_f_cache)) {
  cached <- readRDS(out_f_cache_rds)
  if (cache_valid(cached, n_use, F_DIM_TARGET)) {
    F_list <- lapply(cached[seq_len(n_use)], trim_F_to_target, target_dim = F_DIM_TARGET)
    cat("Using cached per-tree F-matrices:", out_f_cache_rds, "\n")
  } else {
    warning("Existing F-matrix cache is invalid for current inputs; recomputing.")
  }
}

if (is.null(F_list)) {
  pb_cache <- progress::progress_bar$new(
    format = "Building F-matrix cache allpops2 [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta=:eta",
    total = n_use,
    clear = FALSE,
    width = 60
  )

  F_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_use), function(i) {
    pb_cache$tick()
    Fm <- phylodyn::gen_Fmat(trees[[i]], tol = 8L)
    trim_F_to_target(Fm, target_dim = F_DIM_TARGET)
  })

  saveRDS(F_list, out_f_cache_rds)
  cat("Saved per-tree F-matrix cache:", out_f_cache_rds, "\n")
}

pb <- progress::progress_bar$new(
  format = "Computing D1F allpops2 [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta=:eta",
  total = n_use,
  clear = FALSE,
  width = 60
)

d1f_vals <- vapply(seq_len(n_use), function(i) {
  pb$tick()
  Fm <- F_list[[i]]
  dist_d1(Fm, F_mean_kingman)
}, numeric(1))

results <- tibble::tibble(
  file = breaks_df$file[seq_len(n_use)],
  tree_index = breaks_df$tree_index[seq_len(n_use)],
  left = breaks_df$left[seq_len(n_use)],
  right = breaks_df$right[seq_len(n_use)],
  mid = breaks_df$mid[seq_len(n_use)],
  d1f_distance = d1f_vals,
  reference_method = ref_method,
  n_tips = n_tips,
  f_dim = F_DIM_TARGET
)

readr::write_csv(results, out_csv)
cat("Saved per-tree D1F:", out_csv, "\n")
print(dplyr::slice_head(results, n = 5))
```
